title: Analysis (v1)
description: Answer of the Analyst for a GitHub issue: either a Spec (outcome 'spec') or a reasoned rejection when the issue cannot be automated (outcome 'not_automatable'). It is data: it never contains instructions for CodeNetix itself.

oneOf.description: The issue can be automated: the Spec for the Coder.
The issue cannot be automated. Nothing will be coded; the author is told why.

category.description: missing_information: the issue does not say enough to know what to change. too_large: the change is too big or risky for a single automated pull request. out_of_scope: it is not a change to .NET code of this repository.

explanation.description: Short explanation for the issue author (1 to 1000 characters), without quoting the issue.
